minutes.headline: Board funded a town manager recruiter and approved rec director hours; public communications policy dispute left unresolved.
minutes.summary: This was the outgoing town manager's last meeting, with long public comment and farewells. The board continued the Kilburn Street Chapter 61B hearing to August 6, heard a Marshall Park update, and voted on rec director hours, an interim town manager contract, an ARPA recruiter allocation and a sewer agreement. A dispute over whether last week's public communications policy vote was valid ended with no resolution.

public_comment.topic: Praise for the departing town manager and criticism of how the board has treated her.
Unsupervised large fishing events and jet ski safety on the lake, and a slow police response; asks where to turn.
Alleged coordinated harassment, a defamation dispute with the chair, unanswered emails and records requests.
Thanks to the Parks Commission, the board for the ARPA money for Marshall Park, and the town manager.
Unkempt former funeral home property on Massachusetts Avenue; urged cleanup.
Public communications policy as a contract, threatened legal action, objection to AI-generated minutes.
Agreed with earlier speakers and criticized the chair.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the Chapter 61B Kilburn Street notice of intent to August 6.
Approve additional hours for the recreation director as presented by the town manager.
Approve the interim town manager contract as discussed in executive session, contingent on labor counsel review.
Assign ARPA funds for a recruiting firm for the town manager screening committee and request a reserve fund transfer from the finance committee for the same.
Approve the intermunicipal agreement between Leominster and the Lunenburg Sewer Commission.

budget_items.what_was_said: The screening committee asked for authorization and funding for a recruitment firm; fee quoted at a range plus advertising.
Phase one is funded from ARPA, a state park grant and remaining design funds.

budget_items.topic: Marshall Park design contract and grants
budget_items.what_was_said: Phase one design is capped by a not-to-exceed contract; a conditional land and water grant and an accessibility grant application were mentioned.
Earlier schematic estimate for the whole project needs updating before any Town Meeting request.
Hours go up from 19 to 28, paid from the parks revolving account; the town manager gave a lower updated cost.
Board discussed ARPA versus the reserve fund for the recruiter; the amounts as heard differ across lines.
Two warrants were presented, one needing a signature at town hall.
Candidate declined because of the annual pay; the town awaits state cost to do inspections.

Board agreed the recruiting firm may advise on the salary range if engaged.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted unanimously to assign ARPA funds for a recruiting firm for the town manager screening committee and to request a reserve fund transfer for the same.
The board voted unanimously to approve the interim town manager contract discussed in executive session, contingent on labor counsel review.
The board approved additional hours for the recreation director, paid from the parks revolving account, and approved a sewer intermunicipal agreement with Leominster, both unanimously.
A dispute over whether last week's public communications policy vote was valid ended with no resolution and was deferred to a meeting with the full board present.
The Chapter 61B Kilburn Street hearing was continued to August 6, with the open space committee to be asked for input.

why_it_matters: The search for a new town manager is being paid for from ARPA money and possibly the reserve fund, so residents will see the same cost appear in a Finance Committee transfer request.
Whether the public communications policy is in effect is still contested, which affects how residents' comments and records requests are handled until town counsel weighs in.
The Kilburn Street Chapter 61B decision is still open, and it concerns land the town may have a right to consider buying.
watch_next: August 6: the continued Chapter 61B Kilburn Street hearing, with the applicant on the agenda.
The Finance Committee's action on the reserve fund transfer request for the recruiter, and town counsel's answer on the communications policy.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on four of the five votes and on most decisions. Most figure differences are caption garbles, which the official numbers resolve. The main differences are a Kilburn Street 61B hearing continuation that only our minutes record, and who chaired the meeting (ours says Jeff, the official minutes say Nuzzolo).
